deduplication: Unordered actual team pair within pool and fixed reference, across all method/direction/route occurrences. Route/role subgroup counts deduplicate independently and are not additive.
main_noQ_shape: Original strict/main/wide and frozen noQ/shape unchanged. Disagreements describe metric sensitivity; no replacement of the primary endpoint.
prism: Mean-height prism is a proxy. Exact flat-prism IoU requires identified constant ceiling, missing otherwise. >10% boundary-height and proxy<.90 flags are descriptive diagnostics, not new acceptance rules.
quality_reversal: B8 improves >=2 while D10 worsens >=2, or converse. Canonical pair orientation does not alter disagreement.
read_boundary: Only forward/reverse discovery metrics and their selected native final rows. No assessment results or raw observations read, no fusion/scoring/reference/classification changed.
